summary: Ukraine has proposed a ceasefire to Russia regarding strikes on civilian targets in the Black Sea, though no response has been received. Russian Shahed drones attacked passenger trains in Odesa, resulting in two fatalities including a driver and assistant. Multiple UAV incursions were reported across various regions including Chernihiv, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia.
key_points: Ukraine has proposed a ceasefire to Russia via a third party regarding attacks on civilian vessels in the Black Sea (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32441).
A Russian Shahed drone struck a passenger train in Odesa, killing the driver and his assistant (Source: @UkraineNow/83396).
Russia transferred 261 bodies of deceased military personnel to Ukraine during a recent exchange (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32425).
Ukraine received 24 bodies during a civilian exchange conducted at the Belarusian-Ukrainian border (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32440).
The SBU uncovered a Russian agent network of 14 individuals targeting F-16 and Mirage 2000 aircraft (Source: @UkraineNow/83413).
Zelensky stated that Ukraine has requested Patriot missile systems, noting current stocks are at 1% (Source: @UkraineNow/83393).
The remains of OUN founder Konovalets were returned to Ukraine for reburial at the National War Memorial Cemetery (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32435).
Poland is considering transferring another batch of Patriot missiles to Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/83399).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat of UAV strikes on civilian infrastructure remains high, as evidenced by the fatal strike on an Odesa passenger train. The targeting of aviation infrastructure by Russian agent networks indicates an ongoing intelligence threat to Ukrainian air assets. Additionally, the use of reactive UAVs across multiple regions suggests a persistent aerial threat to various Ukrainian territories.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is pursuing diplomatic channels to propose a Black Sea ceasefire and is working to improve its image in Poland. Poland is considering providing additional Patriot missile batteries to Ukraine. Meanwhile, the SBU is actively countering Russian intelligence efforts to monitor sensitive military aviation assets.
sections.intelligence_notes: The transfer of 261 bodies by Russia and 24 by Ukraine highlights the scale of casualties. The transition of the Skyla Regiment to the Azov Corps' operational command marks a significant internal restructuring. The reported embezzlement of 254 million hryvnias from drone purchases by the State Special Communications Service is a noted internal corruption issue.
